# Pins the pip that runs AFTER the bootstrap (REQ-SUP-001-AC13): every job that runs `pip install` first installs this one
# requirement, hash-checked, and every later install of that job (and of each virtual environment it creates) runs under this pip.
# The bootstrap itself runs the runner's existing pip, which checks this wheel's hash before it installs it; that first pip is not pinned.
# Dependabot watches this directory, so a new pip release is proposed as soon as it is published.
